title: 第5章 十方聚气锤第6章 淬体九重夜半杀机
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 炼器房内。
李牧火正鼓动着风箱，进行良铁矿的熔铸。
观摩杨开山锻器两月有余，李牧火自认锻造知识和水平都有了不小的提升。
但越是如此，便越不能自满。
只见，李牧火夹起一块良铁原矿开始用力敲砸，神情专注。
刚挖掘的铁矿是没法直接进行熔铸的，需要挑拣除杂，再用铁锤砸碎，清洗干净后再焙烧稳固矿体。
仅仅这个步骤就耗费了李牧火小半天的工夫。
【你成功焙烧出一块中品良铁，获得1点天地精粹】
【你成功焙烧出一块中品良铁，获得1点天地精粹】
出乎李牧火预料，他甚至还没开始锻造，竟就已经开始收获天地精粹。
直至自己拿来的这些良铁矿全部焙烧完成，李牧火一共得到了12点天地精粹，这使得他尤为亢奋。
“果然，还是得亲手锻造才行啊！”
李牧火此刻目光灼灼，动力满满。
然而，一个时辰后。
李牧火重复第三次熔铸，才堪堪熔铸好一块良铁。
到了这一步，便到了他最熟悉的锻打环节。
“叮当，叮当~”
有节奏的敲击声开始响起。
似乎是被声音吸引，吴道进来看了一眼，当他看见李牧火确实已经开始锻打，眼底不由露出些许惊讶之色。
“师父。”
见吴道前来，李牧火当即便要见礼，吴道则摆了摆手道：“你继续，待你打造一件成品出来后我再看看。”
“是，师父。”
待吴道走后，李牧火继续专注锻打，只是颇为吃力。
饶是他辅助过杨开山，但亲自上手后还是体会到了良铁的锻造难度。无论是锤击的力量需求和把控，还是塑形的难度，都远超贫铁。
终于，在夜幕降临前，李牧火完成了一件铁镐的锻造。
【你成功锻造了一柄下品凡器铁镐，获得2点天地精粹】
“只有2点吗？”
李牧火对这个结果其实是有些失望的，他还是低估了良铁的锻造难度，二师兄说过良铁锻造得好的话，是可以锻造出中品凡器的。若能糅合一丝精铁进去，甚至可以锻造出上品凡器。
“李师兄，吃饭啦！”
正当这时，钱朵朵进来唤李牧火吃饭，见着李牧火拿着铁镐发呆，不由惊讶道：“师兄，你也太厉害了，竟然真的锻造成功了。刚才二师兄还说直接让你上手，有点儿强人所难呢。”
李牧火被钱朵朵这么一夸，顿时心情好了一些。心道来日方长，自己的机会还多着呢。
片刻后，李牧火将这柄铁镐递给吴道，大师兄和二师兄也上前观摩起来。
大师兄仔细端详后，连连点头：“小师弟第一次锻造良铁，能成器就已经很不错了，可见是颇有炼器天赋的。”
content_en:
In the refining room.
Li Muhuo was blowing the bellows to melt and cast good iron ore.
After observing Yang Kaishan's forging for more than two months, Li Muhuo felt that his forging knowledge and level had improved a lot.
But the more so, the less complacent we can be.
I saw Li Muhuo picking up a piece of good iron ore and starting to pound it hard, with a focused look on his face.
The newly excavated iron ore cannot be directly smelted and cast. It needs to be sorted and removed, then smashed with a hammer, cleaned and then roasted to stabilize the ore body.
This step alone took Li Muhuo half a day's work.
[You successfully roasted a piece of medium-grade iron and obtained 1 point of essence of heaven and earth]
[You successfully roasted a piece of medium-grade iron and obtained 1 point of essence of heaven and earth]
Contrary to Li Muhuo's expectation, he had already begun harvesting the essence of heaven and earth before he even started forging.
After all the good iron ore he brought was roasted, Li Muhuo got a total of 12 points of heaven and earth essence, which made him particularly excited.
"Sure enough, you still have to forge it yourself!"
Li Muhuo's eyes were burning at the moment and he was full of motivation.
However, an hour later.
Li Muhuo repeated the casting for the third time before he could cast a good piece of iron.
At this point, he has reached the forging link that he is most familiar with.
"Ding Dong, Ding Dong~"
A rhythmic tapping sound began.
Seemingly attracted by the sound, Wu Dao came in and took a look. When he saw that Li Muhuo had indeed begun to forge, he couldn't help but show a little surprise in his eyes.
"Master."
Seeing Wu Dao coming, Li Muhuo immediately wanted to see him as a gift, but Wu Dao waved his hand and said, "Go on, I'll take a look after you create a finished product."
"Yes, Master."
After Wu Dao left, Li Muhuo continued to focus on forging, but it was quite difficult.
Even though he had assisted Yang Kaishan, he still realized how difficult it was to forge good iron after trying it himself. Whether it is the power requirements and control of hammering, or the difficulty of shaping, it is far beyond that of poor iron.
Finally, before nightfall, Li Muhuo completed the forging of an iron pickaxe.
[You successfully forged a low-grade mortal iron pickaxe and obtained 2 points of heaven and earth essence]
"Only 2 o'clock?"
Li Muhuo was actually a little disappointed with this result. He still underestimated the difficulty of forging good iron. The second senior brother said that if good iron is forged well, middle-grade mortal weapons can be forged. If you can mix a trace of fine iron into it, you can even forge a top-grade mortal weapon.
"Senior Brother Li, it's time to eat!"
At this moment, Qian Duoduo came in to call Li Muhuo to eat. Seeing Li Muhuo holding an iron pick in a daze, he couldn't help but be surprised and said: "Senior brother, you are so awesome, you actually succeeded in forging it. Just now, the second senior brother said that he would let you start directly, which is a bit overwhelming."
Li Muhuo felt better after being praised by Qian Duoduo. I know that the future is long and I still have many opportunities.
After a while, Li Muhuo handed the iron pickaxe to Wu Dao, and his senior brother and second senior brother also stepped forward to observe.
After the senior brother looked at it carefully, he nodded repeatedly: "This is the first time for my junior brother to forge good iron, and it is already very good to be able to turn it into a weapon. It shows that he is quite talented in weapon refining."
